LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 6.3.1 WORD CLASSES: ADVERBS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.3: Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs, part of Strand 6 in Grade 7 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to describe where, when and how events happen?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify adverbs of time, place, and manner in texts,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. use adverbs of time, place, and manner in different contexts,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. acknowledge the value of adverbs of manner, time, and place in communication.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. identify adverbs of time, place, and manner in texts,

   Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. use adverbs of time, place, and manner in different contexts,

   Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. acknowledge the value of adverbs of manner, time, and place in communication.

   Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read a print or non-print text on drug and substance abuse in pairs,

2. identify the adverbs of time, place, and manner used in the text,

3. categorise adverbs of time, place, and manner from word lists or flashcards,

4. construct sentences using adverbs of time, place, and manner,

5. use adverbs of time, place, and manner in a role play, hot seating or simulation and make a video recording,

6. share a story or dialogue featuring adverbs of time, place, and manner.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read a print or non-print text on drug and substance abuse in pairs,
2. identify the adverbs of time, place, and manner used in the text,
3. categorise adverbs of time, place, and manner from word lists or flashcards,
4. construct sentences using adverbs of time, place, and manner,
5. use adverbs of time, place, and manner in a role play, hot seating or simulation and make a video recording,
6. share a story or dialogue featuring adverbs of time, place, and manner.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and problem solving: It is enhanced as the learner thinks of different ways of describing manner, time, and

place.

• Learning to learn: It is developed when the learner organises own learning as they identify and use different types of adverbs.

Values

Responsibility is developed as the learner records videos and describes the events with peers.

Main points to remember:

1. identify adverbs of time, place, and manner in texts,
2. use adverbs of time, place, and manner in different contexts,
3. acknowledge the value of adverbs of manner, time, and place in communication.

Remember the key question: Why is it important to describe where, when and how events happen?
